title: Running Commentary on Torah 47 — Va-Achaltem Achol v-Savo'a
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 47 — ואכלתם אכול ושבוע
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Three-layer line-by-line gloss: beginner = readable English prose with bracketed translations; intermediate = compact bilingual summary with citations; scholarly = terse Hebrew citation list. 13-segment coarse structure contains two overlapping versions of the drasha: segs 1-5 are Rabbeinu's lashon (short); seg 6 is Reb Nosson's editorial note explaining that he wrote this Torah from memory first and found more-detailed explanations; segs 7-13 are R"N's fuller expansion (with Rabbeinu's 'v-achaltem' peirush partially missing in the original and supplied from R"N's own recollection). Torah 47 threads together: ta'avas-achilah → sheker + dinim + aniyus + bushos; breaking ta'avah → ish-mofes + n-si'as-panim (via the Berachos-20a 'k-zayis-k-beitzah' chidush); Eretz Yisrael = eretz-ha-chayim = receives from Yaakov = emes = tefilin = pe'er; EY's lechem-non-b-miskenus; 'ha-nosen imrei shefer' = shefer/pe'er/tefilin; ishah-R"T-He-Aleph-Shin; Naftali-osiyos-tefilin; the messianic peak — breaking ta'avas-achilah + praising HKBH → becoming shutaf-ha-Kadosh-Baruch-Hu in briyah = new shamayim + aretz + mazalos.
